name: How long does interior framing take for a basement remodel or room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does interior framing take for a basement remodel or room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing an average unfinished basement or standard room alteration typically takes between 2 to 5 working days, depending on square footage, ceiling height, and design complexity. A simple open perimeter and utility closet can be framed quickly, while custom layouts with multiple bedrooms, soffits to conceal ductwork, bathroom pockets, and egress window wraps take longer. Once interior framing is complete and inspected, the project moves smoothly into rough-in mechanicals with licensed plumbers and electricians, followed by insulation, drywall hanging, taping, and finish carpentry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing typically takes 2 to 5 days depending on the layout, ceiling height, and features like bulkheads, soffits, and rough openings for doors and closets.
